query: with chosen as(select * from public.works where open_library_id=any(array['OL20214285W','OL3511459W','OL19655889W','OL20333471W','OL15100470W','OL24477958W','OL2271589W','OL5725961W','OL134383W','OL81607W','OL81589W','OL17373843W','OL149119W','OL81586W','OL17875641W','OL17453058W','OL1041829W','OL17817705W']::text[])) select jsonb_build_object('checked_at',clock_timestamp(),'works',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(w) order by id),'[]') from chosen w),'authors',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) order by id),'[]') from public.authors a where open_library_id=any(array['OL19981A','OL30765A','OL359235A','OL7115219A','OL1392395A','OL34328A','OL21718A','OL102484A','OL7668903A','OL587370A','OL296646A','OL21976A','OL7468980A','OL7414674A']::text[])),'editions',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e) order by id),'[]') from public.editions e where work_id in(select id from chosen) or isbn_13=any(array['9789029511643','9789048813834','9780713904666','9789000360475','9781635575613','9789045043012','9780804172721','9789046705872','9780767919388','9789021026701','9789021828237','9789047500469','9789024513345','9789024519880','9789024557745','9789083267432','9789024528080','9789024539147','9789000364503','9789023491453','9789045800738','9789000345496']::text[])),'descriptions',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d) order by work_id,language),'[]') from public.catalog_work_descriptions d where work_id in(select id from chosen)),'metadata',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(m) order by edition_id),'[]') from public.catalog_edition_metadata m where work_id in(select id from chosen))) as preflight;
